en.title: Total Number of Teams Within a Skill Range
en.description:
From the given players choose at least minPlayers people whose skills all lie in [minLevel,maxLevel]; find the number of teams, counted as distinct index sets. No modulo is taken.

The standard input/output format and examples were compiled by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n minPlayers minLevel maxLevel, and the second line contains the skills. The original text has no numeric bounds; on this site 1≤n≤10000, 1≤minPlayers≤n, −10^9≤skills and both bounds≤10^9, and minLevel≤maxLevel.
en.explanation: The examples give 4, 7 and 0 respectively. Different players with the same skill count as different individuals.
hints: First count the number m of qualified players, then compute the binomial coefficients C(m,k) iteratively and sum those with k≥minPlayers. Use arbitrary-precision integers.
